title: Order of a Sign Multi-Index
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$ and every multi-index $a:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{0,1\}$, its order, defined as the number of coordinates where it is nonzero, equals the cardinality of its support.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a multi-index with values in $\{0,1\}$
